entries.title: Archives New Zealand Information and Records Management Standard
entries.use: recordkeeping, accessibility, lifecycle, and accountability vocabulary only; no regulated-organisation, legal, access, retention, or disposal decision

entries.title: New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 principles 6 and 7 access and correction surfaces
entries.use: access-request, correction-request, and attached-statement vocabulary only; no legal interpretation, privacy remedy, identity finding, or agency decision

entries.title: W3C PROV-O
entries.use: entity activity derivation revision attribution and provenance vocabulary only; no conformance

entries.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
entries.use: structural accessibility vocabulary with manual assistive-technology and affected-user evaluation reserved

entries.title: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0
entries.use: synthetic issuer-holder-verifier role vocabulary and privacy refusal conditions only; no keys, proofs, credential lifecycle, identity, interoperability, or trust-governance claim

entries.title: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme
entries.use: deterministic synthetic receipt serialization and content-address vocabulary only; no signature, identity, authenticity, or security-completeness claim

entries.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
entries.use: synthetic record validation and declared-vocabulary concepts only

entries.title: Te Mana Raraunga Principles of Māori Data Sovereignty
entries.use: Māori data-governance vacancy and noncompensation boundary only; never delegated Māori authority
